ja.description: 初代スマブラのキャラクター選択画面で、12キャラクターだけを選べます。

patches.note: get_character_id_ (RAM 0x8051EE10): the d-pad variant step becomes a filter. Ids 0x00-0x0B pass, anything else becomes NONE, so Remix portraits, bonus fighters and variants can't be hovered or picked on any CSS
get_character_id_ (RAM 0x8051ED68): send the 12-Character Battle result through the same filter
CharacterSelect.get_random_char_id_ (RAM 0x8051F24C): always use Remix's VANILLA random mode (random "?", L-button random, new CPU panels, Tag Team random)
TwelveCharBattle.get_random_char_id_ (RAM 0x804FBDAC): always use the VANILLA random mode in 12-Character Battle
TwelveCharBattle.update_character_set_ (RAM 0x804F9EC0): 12-Character Battle stays on the Default (vanilla) character set; Japanese/Polygon/Remix/Custom can't be chosen
Character.variants.table rows 0x00-0x0B (RAM 0x8049C9A0): the vanilla fighters get no d-pad variants, so the panels don't show variant icons

Safety net code in the unreachable rest of the old variant step (RAM 0x8051EE24): when the VS CSS opens, a restored non-vanilla character becomes NONE (costume 0), and a CPU panel holding one is closed
TwelveCharBattle.setup_ports_and_characters_ (RAM 0x804F8A90): return to the VS CSS through that safety net

mnPlayersVSCheckFighterLocked (VS overlay RAM 0x80132044): never locked, so the original screen never hides Luigi/Ness/Falcon/Jigglypuff (Remix unlocks them anyway) and mnPlayersVSMakePortraitShadow's space is free for the code below
dMNPlayersVSFileIDs[5] (RAM 0x8013B3B4): load file 0x13 (original portraits, still in the ROM unchanged) again; Remix had replaced it with 0
mnPlayersVSMakePortrait (RAM 0x80132520): Remix's jr ra becomes a jump to a 12cb check, so the original portraits are drawn (not in 12-Character Battle)
mnPlayersVSGetNextPortraitX (RAM 0x80131DC8): original slide-in tables (0x8013B3F0/0x8013B420) unless 12cb, where Remix's tables are used as before
mnPlayersVSGetPortrait (RAM 0x80132168): fighter -> original portrait (table 0x8013B504) unless 12cb, where TwelveCharBattle.get_portrait_id_ is used as before
mnPlayersVSGetPuckFighterKind hook (RAM 0x8013786C): run the original hit test (12 original fighters only) unless 12cb, where CharacterSelect.get_character_id_ is used as before
mnPlayersVSCenterPuckInPortrait hook (RAM 0x801387A8): original token placement unless 12cb (Remix's place_token_from_id_)
CharacterSelect.select_random_char_ (RAM 0x80523254): L-button random places the token through the same dispatcher
mnPlayersVSMakePortraitFlash (RAM 0x801364C4): white flash on the original display link (30) unless 12cb (Remix's 0x12)
mnPlayersVSMakePortraitFlash (RAM 0x801364F4): white flash on the original display layer (37) unless 12cb (Remix's 0x1B)
mnPlayersVSMakePortraitFlash (RAM 0x80136524): original white square at the original place unless 12cb (Remix's code, still in place)
mnPlayersVSPuckAdjustPortraitEdge (RAM 0x801394AC): placed tokens drift inside the original portrait (x) unless 12cb
mnPlayersVSPuckAdjustPortraitEdge (RAM 0x80139540): ... (y) unless 12cb
mnPlayersVSPuckAdjustPortraitEdge (RAM 0x8013956C): ... original portrait width 45 unless 12cb
mnPlayersVSPuckAdjustPortraitEdge (RAM 0x801395AC): ... original portrait height 43 unless 12cb
mnPlayersVSPuckAdjustPlaced (RAM 0x801396CC): original spacing 15 between tokens on the same fighter unless 12cb (Remix's 10)
VS overlay RAM 0x801391A8: original instructions (Remix shrank new tokens to 0.8125; its 12cb path already ran these)
VS overlay RAM 0x80138764: original instructions (token shrink on HMN/CPU switch)
VS overlay RAM 0x80138A00: original held-token x offset 11
VS overlay RAM 0x80138A10: original held-token y offset -14
CharacterSelect.draw_portraits_ (RAM 0x80520B10): draw nothing on the VS screen outside 12cb (no Remix grid, bookends or "?"); 1P/Training/Bonus/12cb unchanged
The 12cb-or-original dispatchers (VS overlay RAM 0x801321B8, in mnPlayersVSMakePortraitShadow's space, unreachable after the CheckFighterLocked edit)
